defects.claim: Description: 'Lean the upper back and one shoulder against the tree trunk... Push the hips slightly forward of the shoulders for a flattering angle.' Requires upper back + shoulder AGAINST tree (behind body, z negative) and hips FORWARD of shoulders. Under CORRECTED convention 'spine + = forward lean, - = backward arch', spine must be NEGATIVE (backward arch) to put shoulders behind hips. Current spine=+14 (forward lean) puts shoulders at z=+0.135 (FORWARD of hips at z=0) — OPPOSITE of description.
defects.evidence: geometry.json: torso_flexion_deg=+14, shoulders z=+0.135, hips z=0.000, head z=+0.194 (all forward of hips, leaning AWAY from tree).

defects.claim: Description: 'the other bends with the sole resting against the bark' — sole of bent leg's foot pressed against tree trunk BEHIND body. Current leftKnee=65 produces foot at z=+0.450 (FORWARD of body, not against tree behind). Rig limitation: positive knee in standing context (hip=0) folds shin FORWARD despite 'shin bends backward' convention (worker-A-batch3 finding for back-wall-prop). Workaround: leftHip:-30 (leg swings back) + leftKnee:80 (deeper flexion) brings knee to z=-0.193 (behind body). Foot still at z=+0.221 (forward) due to shin-fold direction — partial achievement only.
defects.evidence: geometry.json: leftFoot z=+0.450 (forward, not against tree behind).

failing_tests.actual: spine=+14 (forward lean, shoulders at z=+0.135 forward of hips)

regression_risk: medium — spine sign flip dramatically reorients upper body (shoulders move from forward to behind). Combined with leg adjustment (leftHip:-30 outside default), visual re-render verification recommended before integration.
rationale: CRITICAL fix: spine sign flip 14→-14 (backward arch per CORRECTED convention 'spine - = backward arch') puts shoulders at z=-0.135 and head at z=-0.194 (behind hips, against tree trunk) — matches 'Lean the upper back and one shoulder against the tree trunk' ✓ and 'Push the hips slightly forward of the shoulders' (hips z=0 > shoulders z=-0.135 ✓). MAJOR partial fix for foot-against-tree: leftHip 0→-30 (leg swings back, knee moves to z=-0.193 behind body) + leftKnee 65→80 (deeper flexion). Foot ends at z=+0.221 (still forward of body) due to rig limitation — positive knee in standing context folds shin FORWARD (worker-A-batch3 finding for back-wall-prop, gate-lean, glass-lean — all standing poses with foot-behind-wall descriptions). The knee is now correctly behind body (z=-0.193) and foot is raised (y=-0.509, off ground) — partial achievement of 'sole resting against bark'. Renderer tier-3 fix needed for true foot-behind-body in standing context (knee sign convention context-aware OR separate hip-extension-aware foot positioning joint).
